prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent decorative website illustration
Input images: Image 1 is the style reference only; match its loose hand-drawn material, mark-making, simplified anatomy, and imperfect finish, but do not copy the cheetah subject.
Primary request: Draw one small grain-eating seed bird in vivid pink.
Subject: a finch-like bird in full-body side profile, standing calmly with its head tipped slightly toward three tiny grain seeds near its beak; recognizable but charmingly imperfect.
Style/medium: loose wax crayon or oil pastel, with uneven pressure, chunky doubled marks, wobbly contours, visible rubbed pigment, and simple hand-drawn feather marks. It should feel made by the same hand as the supplied cobalt cheetah.
Composition/framing: the complete bird and three seeds are fully visible, centered with generous transparent space around them.
Color palette: one vivid warm pink only, including the seeds; no black outlines and no additional colors.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background; no branch, ground line, landscape, text, border, shadow, gradient, polished vector finish, or extra objects.
